Definition: a diminutive of G976; a roll:--bill, book, scroll, writing.
BiblicalUsage: A book in the New Testament is a scroll, a roll of writing — and the word covers everything from a bill of divorcement to the book of life. In Matthew 19:7 the Pharisees ask about Moses' writing of divorcement, in Luke 4:17 the book of Isaiah is handed to Jesus in the synagogue, in John 20:30 John says many other signs are not written in this book, and in Revelation 5:1 John sees a book sealed with seven seals in the Father's hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the book in Revelation is the one that matters most: sealed until the Lamb takes it, and then opened for the whole world.
